blocks.text: Interphase mein chromatin ki duplication (dugna hona) bhi hoti hai: DNA ki replication (copy banna) hoti hai aur naye histone proteins bante hain. Duplication ke baad har chromosome do aik jaise strands ka hota hai jinhein chromatids kehte hain; yeh dono sister chromatids kehlate hain. Yeh aik tang (constricted) jagah par aapas mein jure hote hain jise centromere kehte hain. Kitab ke mutabiq centromere taqreeban 220 nucleotides ka aik khaas DNA sequence hai. Centromere se disc jaisa aik protein structure jura hota hai jise kinetochore kehte hain. Cell division ke dauran chromosome isi jagah se mitotic spindle (division ke waqt banne wale dhaagon) se jurta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Chromosomes ko German embryologist Walther Flemming ne 1882 mein salamander ke larvae ke tezi se divide hone wale cells mein daryaft kiya. “Chromosome” naam German anatomist Waldeyer-Hartz ne 1888 mein rakha. “Chromosome” ka lafzi matlab hai rangeen ajsaam (coloured bodies).

blocks.alt: Duplicate aur gaarha chromosome: do neele sister chromatids jo tang centromere par jure hain; centromere ke dono taraf gehra kinetochore, oopar patli secondary constriction jis par gol satellite laga hai, aur neeche chromatids ke sire.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Sister chromatids, Secondary constriction, Satellite, Kinetochore, Centromere, Telomere.

blocks.text: Kuch chromosomes mein aik doosri tangi bhi hoti hai jise secondary constriction ya Nuclear Organizer Region (NOR) kehte hain; yeh interphase mein nucleoli banata hai. Secondary constriction ke saath chromosome ka sira gaanth (knob) jaisa hota hai jise satellite kehte hain. Is hisse mein bohat zyada dohraye jane wale DNA sequences hote hain jinhein kitab junk DNA kehti hai. Chromosomes ke aakhri siron ko telomeres kehte hain; yeh do chromosomes ko apne siron se aapas mein jurne nahin dete.

Har chromosome mein centromere ki jagah alag hoti hai. Jin chromosomes mein centromere bilkul beech (centre) mein ho, woh metacentric kehlate hain. Jin mein centromere beech se thora hat kar ho, woh sub-metacentric hain. Acrocentric chromosomes mein centromere sire ke qareeb hota hai, aur telocentric chromosomes mein bilkul sire par.

blocks.alt: Chaar duplicate chromosomes jin mein surmai centromere mukhtalif jaghon par hai: beech mein (Metacentric), beech se zara hat kar (Submetacentric), aik sire ke bohat qareeb jahan chhote bazu bohat chhote hain (Acrocentric), aur bilkul sire par jahan chhota bazu nahi (Telocentric).

blocks.prompt: Cell division mein spindle chromosome se kahan jurti hai, aur telomeres kya kaam karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Spindle kinetochore se jurti hai, jo centromere par laga protein disc hai. Telomeres chromosomes ke aakhri sire hain jo do chromosomes ko siron se aapas mein jurne nahin dete.

items: Duplicate chromosome: centromere par jure do sister chromatids; kinetochore par spindle jurti hai.
Secondary constriction (NOR) nucleoli banata hai; us ke saath satellite; siron par telomeres.
Centromere ki jagah se chaar qismein: metacentric, sub-metacentric, acrocentric, telocentric.
